turns.text: yes! i rsvp'd last week, im bringing Padraig

turns.speaker: Harsimran
turns.text: wait since when are you and Padraig a thing

turns.speaker: Eluned
turns.text: like a month? we met at that trivia night in april. no wait, end of march, it was the week before my birthday

turns.speaker: Harsimran
turns.text: omg and you didnt tell me

turns.speaker: Eluned
turns.text: im telling you now! its not a big deal yet

turns.speaker: Harsimran
turns.text: ok ok. i need a dress, all of mine are from like 2018

turns.speaker: Eluned
turns.text: try the vintage place on the corner, thats where i got my green one

turns.speaker: Harsimran
turns.text: the green one is so nice. but i hate shopping, it takes me four hours to buy socks

turns.speaker: Eluned
turns.text: lol i'll come with you on saturday

turns.speaker: Harsimran
turns.text: yes please. if i win the lottery before then im just getting one made

turns.speaker: Eluned
turns.text: and if you dont?

turns.speaker: Harsimran
turns.text: then vintage it is

turns.speaker: Eluned
turns.text: saturday then, 11ish?

turns.speaker: Mitsuki
turns.text: you werent at the gym this morning, everything ok?

turns.speaker: Ugonna
turns.text: nah i hurt my back on tuesday carrying a sofa for my neighbour

turns.speaker: Mitsuki
turns.text: ouch, is it bad?

turns.speaker: Ugonna
turns.text: not too bad, doctor said rest for two weeks and absolutely no deadlifts

turns.speaker: Mitsuki
turns.text: two weeks off, you're gonna go insane

turns.speaker: Ugonna
turns.text: already am lol. i watched an entire cooking show in two days

turns.speaker: Mitsuki
turns.text: wait which one

turns.speaker: Ugonna
turns.text: the baking one where everyone cries. im gonna try making bread this weekend

turns.speaker: Mitsuki
turns.text: haha nice, bring me some

turns.speaker: Ugonna
turns.text: if its edible, sure

turns.speaker: Mitsuki
turns.text: oh btw Dongha switched to the evening classes, so its just us two in the 6am group now

turns.speaker: Ugonna
turns.text: aw i'll miss him. also i said tuesday but it was wednesday actually, tuesday i was stuck at work late

turns.speaker: Mitsuki
turns.text: lol ok wednesday, noted. get better soon

turns.speaker: Ugonna
turns.text: thanks, see you in two weeks hopefully

turns.speaker: Refilwe
turns.text: hi Gyula, is that your parcel in the hallway?

turns.speaker: Gyula
turns.text: oh yes thank you, its a new kettle, the old one started smoking last week

turns.speaker: Refilwe
turns.text: smoking?? thats scary

turns.speaker: Gyula
turns.text: very. my cat Marzipan ran under the sofa and didnt come out for hours

turns.speaker: Refilwe
turns.text: poor thing. are you staying here for the holidays?

turns.speaker: Gyula
turns.text: no, im going to my daughters for christmas, from the 22nd to the 2nd

turns.speaker: Refilwe
turns.text: nice. do you need someone to feed Marzipan?

turns.speaker: Gyula
turns.text: would you? that would be wonderful. she eats twice a day, morning and evening

turns.speaker: Refilwe
turns.text: of course. i fed the upstairs dog in the summer and it went fine

turns.speaker: Gyula
turns.text: haha the one that barks at the postman

turns.speaker: Refilwe
turns.text: thats the one. also did you hear theyre redoing the roof in march

turns.speaker: Gyula
turns.text: yes, the letter came on friday. more drilling, wonderful

turns.speaker: Refilwe
turns.text: at least the leaks will stop

turns.speaker: Gyula
turns.text: true. i'll drop off a spare key on the 21st

turns.speaker: Octavio
turns.text: hey are you still coming to help me move the couch saturday

turns.speaker: Yesenia
turns.text: yes but only if you feed me. pizza minimum

turns.speaker: Octavio
turns.text: deal. the new place has a balcony btw, im gonna grow chillies

turns.speaker: Yesenia
turns.text: you killed three basil plants in 2020

turns.speaker: Octavio
turns.text: those basil plants had issues

turns.speaker: Yesenia
turns.text: lol ok. how far is it from your work now

turns.speaker: Octavio
turns.text: 15 minutes by bike instead of an hour on two buses, its a game changer

turns.speaker: Yesenia
turns.text: nice. btw i finally quit the choir, last rehearsal was thursday

turns.speaker: Octavio
turns.text: wait why, you loved it

turns.speaker: Yesenia
turns.text: the new director Eusebio is kind of a tyrant, he makes us rehearse the same bar for 40 minutes

turns.speaker: Octavio
turns.text: oof. i'd quit too

turns.speaker: Yesenia
turns.text: im thinking of joining a hiking group instead, theres one that meets the first sunday of every month

turns.speaker: Octavio
turns.text: you hate mud though

turns.speaker: Yesenia
turns.text: i hate mud less than i hate Eusebio

turns.speaker: Octavio
turns.text: fair. saturday at 10 then?

turns.speaker: Yesenia
turns.text: 10 works, see you

turns.speaker: Ffion
turns.text: last day of term, i can finally breathe

turns.speaker: Suhail
turns.text: same, my class had a water balloon fight and i got completley soaked

turns.speaker: Ffion
turns.text: lol perfect ending. any plans for the summer?

turns.speaker: Suhail
turns.text: two weeks visiting friends up north in august, then mostly sleeping

turns.speaker: Ffion
turns.text: im finally doing my driving test on the 19th

turns.speaker: Suhail
turns.text: oh good luck! didnt you fail the first one in march?

turns.speaker: Ffion
turns.text: february actually, and yes, i clipped a curb

turns.speaker: Suhail
turns.text: happens to everyone

turns.speaker: Ffion
turns.text: my instructor Anacleto says im ready this time but he says that to everyone

turns.speaker: Suhail
turns.text: haha. hey did you hear Grainne is going part time next year

turns.speaker: Ffion
turns.text: yeah she told me in may, she wants more time for her candle business

turns.speaker: Suhail
turns.text: good for her, i'd do the same if i had a side hustle

turns.speaker: Ffion
turns.text: you could sell your terrible puns

turns.speaker: Suhail
turns.text: people would pay me to stop

turns.speaker: Tigist
turns.text: did you finish the book for thursday?

turns.speaker: Levente
turns.text: half. its so slow, 100 pages about a lighthouse

turns.speaker: Tigist
turns.text: i actually loved it lol

turns.speaker: Levente
turns.text: of course you did, you also liked the one about the salt merchants

turns.speaker: Tigist
turns.text: that one was a masterpiece and i will die on this hill

turns.speaker: Levente
turns.text: anyway, i moved into the new flat last weekend!

turns.speaker: Tigist
turns.text: finally!! hows the place

turns.speaker: Levente
turns.text: small but the light is amazing. and no more upstairs neighbour vacuuming at midnight

turns.speaker: Tigist
turns.text: bless. housewarming party soon?

turns.speaker: Levente
turns.text: thinking the 28th, nothing big, maybe 8 people

turns.speaker: Tigist
turns.text: i'll be there. also i gave up coffee, im on green tea now

turns.speaker: Levente
turns.text: wait since when??

turns.speaker: Tigist
turns.text: two weeks ago. my doctor thinks my heart racing thing might be the caffiene

turns.speaker: Levente
turns.text: huh ok. im not giving up mine, dont even ask

turns.speaker: Tigist
turns.text: wasnt going to lol

turns.speaker: Sione
turns.text: so how did the interview go

turns.speaker: Sione
turns.text: thats a great sign!

turns.speaker: Sione

turns.text: lol classic rabbit

turns.speaker: Sione

turns.speaker: Hannelore
turns.text: thats the spirit

turns.text: next game is away, 2 hours drive, and coach Tevita wants us there by 8am

turns.text: 8am on a sunday?? who does that

turns.speaker: Sione
turns.text: Tevita does, apparently

turns.speaker: Hannelore
turns.text: lol well good luck. i'll let you know about round two

turns.text: back from holiday and my inbox has 300 emails, fantastic

turns.speaker: Csaba
turns.text: welcome back! how was the coast

turns.speaker: Madhavi
turns.text: amazing, we went on a boat trip and i saw dolphins for the first time

turns.text: jealous. meanwhile we moved to the 4th floor while you were gone

turns.text: wait we moved?? where is my desk

turns.text: by the window, next to Ildiko. i saved you the good chair

turns.text: youre a hero

turns.text: i know. also i signed up for japanese classes, mondays and wednesdays after work

turns.speaker: Madhavi
turns.text: since when do you want to learn japanese

turns.speaker: Csaba
turns.text: since the trip in may, i couldnt read a single menu

turns.text: lol fair. is the team lunch still on friday?

turns.speaker: Csaba
turns.text: moved to thursday, Mircea is off on friday

turns.speaker: Madhavi
turns.text: ok thursday. first i need to dig myself out of this inbox

turns.speaker: Csaba
turns.text: good luck, see you at standup

turns.speaker: Wambui
turns.text: maybe, i have to record the podcast in the morning

turns.text: haha. whats it about again

turns.speaker: Dariush
turns.text: thats so cool, i'd listen to that

turns.text: so how was the half marathon last sunday?

turns.speaker: Wambui
turns.text: still amazing, i cant even run for a bus

turns.speaker: Dariush
turns.text: ok so market sunday afternoon? like 3?

turns.speaker: Wambui
turns.text: 3 works. i want those cinnamon things again

turns.text: did you remember to pay the internet bill

turns.speaker: Jurgis
turns.text: yes on tuesday. wait no, i scheduled it for friday

turns.speaker: Ketaki
turns.text: ok as long as it goes through before the 15th

turns.speaker: Jurgis
turns.text: it will. hows your first week at the clinic going

turns.speaker: Ketaki
turns.text: tiring but good. the receptionist Evangelia already knows everyones name, shes a machine

turns.speaker: Jurgis
turns.text: lol. i might be late tonight, the team is going for drinks after work

turns.speaker: Ketaki
turns.text: fine but dont wake me up at 2am again like last time

turns.speaker: Jurgis
turns.text: that was ONE time

turns.speaker: Ketaki
turns.text: it was twice

turns.text: ok fine, twice

turns.text: ok i'll tell him we'll grab it this weekend

turns.speaker: Ludovica
turns.text: this heat is unreal, im melting

turns.speaker: Babajide
turns.text: same. i went to the pool at 7am just to feel alive

turns.speaker: Ludovica
turns.text: wait you swim now?

turns.speaker: Babajide
turns.text: since march! took lessons with Shlomo, he runs the adult beginners class at the pool

turns.speaker: Ludovica
turns.text: thats awesome, last summer you wouldnt even go near the lake

turns.speaker: Babajide
turns.text: still a bit scared honestly, i mostly stay in the shallow end lol

turns.speaker: Ludovica
turns.text: baby steps. oh i didnt tell you, i adopted a cat!

turns.speaker: Babajide
turns.text: no way, whats the name

turns.speaker: Ludovica
turns.text: Figaro, hes black and white and extremely dramatic

turns.speaker: Babajide
turns.text: perfect name for a dramatic cat

turns.speaker: Ludovica
turns.text: he knocked my coffee off the table this morning while looking me dead in the eye

turns.speaker: Babajide
turns.text: villain behaviour. are you still going to the concert next saturday

turns.speaker: Ludovica
turns.text: yes, Avigail got us tickets, i owe her like 60 euros

turns.speaker: Babajide
turns.text: have fun, send me videos

turns.speaker: Ludovica
turns.text: only if Figaro lets me leave the house
